gloss: the next day; the following day

definitions.gloss: the next day; the following day
definitions.explanation: The day after a referenced event or point in time. A formal or written alternative to the more conversational 次の日.

examples.japanese: {翌日|よくじつ}、{彼|かれ}から{連絡|れんらく}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: The next day, I heard from him.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{翌日|よくじつ}に{結果|けっか}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The results were announced the day after the exam.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}の{翌日|よくじつ}、{川|かわ}の{水位|すいい}がかなり{上|あ}がっていた。
examples.english: The day after the heavy rain, the river water level had risen considerably.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written word. In conversation, {次|つぎ}の{日|ひ} or {明|あ}くる{日|ひ} are more common. Often used in news reports, narratives, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌日|よくじつ}の{朝|あさ} (the following morning)
- その{翌日|よくじつ} (the day after that)
- {到着|とうちゃく}{翌日|よくじつ} (the day after arrival)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {翌年|よくねん}: the following year
- {翌月|よくげつ}: the following month
- {翌週|よくしゅう}: the following week
- {前日|ぜんじつ}: the previous day

cross_references.label: two days before (a specified event or date)
